q.g: In this quest you have to find Sanitar's Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol and his Marked Ophthalmoscope on Shoreline. The surgery kit can be found on the second floor of the office building at the pier, located on top of a wardrobe. The ophthalmoscope can be found inside the locked villa in the western part of the map, near the swamp. You need a Cottage back door key to unlock the back door to enter the villa. The ophthalmoscope can be found in the left hand room on the second floor, inside a potted plant on the table.

sh.c: Surgery kit on top of the wardrobe
The wanted villa marked on map
The wanted villa from the backside with back door
